description: Label Studio bumps are not automerged at any level, patch included: the container runs Django's `migrate` unattended on every start, and 5 of the 6 patch spans upstream has ever published (1.8.1-1.8.2, 1.9.1-1.9.2, 1.10.0-1.10.1, 1.12.0-1.12.1, 1.13.0-1.13.1) carry migrations - one of them a squashed `users` migration - against a database that holds the operator's labelled datasets.

`versioning=semver` on the annotation in defaults/main.yml is what keeps that decision on real releases: of the 7384 tags heartexlabs/label-studio publishes, strict semver leaves the 44 `X.Y.Z` ones and discards the release-candidate builds (`1.13.0rc<sha>`), the `.post0` re-releases and the branch flavours.
